    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 10pt"><b>Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election
of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 10pt">On October 6, 2026, Quest Diagnostics Incorporated (the &#8220;Company&#8221;)
announced that Catherine T. Doherty will retire in July 2027. Until then, effective November 1, 2026, Ms. Doherty will transition to a
new role as Executive Vice President with responsibilities including health systems, the Company&#8217;s joint venture with Corewell Health,
and Project Nova, the Company&#8217;s multi-year project to modernize its &#8220;Order to Cash&#8221; business processes, which includes
the related information technology infrastructure and underlying enabling technologies. In connection with this transition, the Company&#8217;s
Compensation and Leadership Development Committee (the &#8220;Committee&#8221;) approved no change to Ms. Doherty&#8217;s annual base
salary of $650,000 or annual incentive compensation under the Company's Senior Management Incentive Plan with a target amount of 80% of
base salary. The Committee also approved an equity award under the Company&#8217;s Employee Long-Term Incentive Plan (&#8220;Employee
Plan&#8221;) with a grant date of November 3, 2026 and a target value of $1,200,000, allocated 100% to restricted stock units. This award
will be subject to terms and conditions that are substantially the same as the annual long-term incentive awards granted under the Employee
Plan in 2026 to other Company senior executives.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 10pt; text-align: center">&#160;</p>
